title: Operator access review and deprovisioning execution proof
riskTreatment: mitigate local execution-proof ambiguity with deterministic PDP, membership, and audit proof; defer provider-console and environment-promotion operation

executionSemantics.syntheticDataBoundary: synthetic tenant, actors, service ids, membership records, and value-free audit evidence only
executionSemantics.accessReviewWorkflow: security-admin PDP permit, tenant-admin denial, cross-tenant denial, and provider-readiness audit marker per in-scope service row
executionSemantics.deprovisioningWorkflow: security-admin PDP permit for tenant-members.delete, membership status changed to revoked, and revoked actor denied before next provider-readiness decision
executionSemantics.auditEvidence: authorization.decision and provider.readiness.checked events recorded through InMemoryAuditEventStore and hash-chain verified
executionSemantics.retentionPosture: proof output and committed evidence artefacts retained as local PR evidence; no production retention claim
executionSemantics.redactionPosture: proof asserts output does not contain raw endpoints, tokens, credentials, connection strings, stack traces, object keys, or provider payloads

serviceExecutionRows.accessReviewWorkflowEvidence: corepack pnpm proof:operator-lifecycle proves security-admin review execution, tenant-admin denial, cross-tenant denial, and value-free audit evidence for this service row
serviceExecutionRows.deprovisioningWorkflowEvidence: corepack pnpm proof:operator-lifecycle proves PDP-authorized local deprovisioning and revoked-membership fail-closed behaviour for this service row
serviceExecutionRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Local synthetic PDP, membership, and audit proof is not equivalent to provider-console SSO, external IdP lifecycle integration, public gateway exposure, environment promotion, or production operator readiness.
